docs.title: PsyScripts — Documentation
docs.meta: Documentation for all PsyScripts: attributes, examples and JS API.

docs.intro.one: {n} script, zero dependencies. Everything works through data attributes; the JS API is only for special cases.
docs.intro.other: {n} scripts, zero dependencies. Everything works through data attributes; the JS API is only for special cases.

docs.install.p: One line, bundle + css, or individually (core.min.js + https://psyscripts.vercel.app/dist/<name>.min.js). Styles (Tabs and icons included) live in psyscripts.min.css. The path and SRI hash of every script are in the “Include on its own” block of its section and in “Files & SRI”.
docs.core.p: Include core.min.js (already inside the bundle). Every script reads options from data attributes, PsyScripts.configure() or PsyScripts.opts(el, …).
docs.files.none: The manifest appears after npm run build.
docs.tabs.d: Accessible tabs: arrow keys, Home/End, roving tabindex.
docs.tabs.api: PsyScripts.Tabs.init(root, opts), .get(el) → {go(i), next(), prev(), index, destroy()}; event tabs:change
docs.tabs.o0: auto — arrows activate the tab; manual — Enter/click only
docs.tabs.a1: tab button; aria-selected="true" marks the default one
docs.tabs.a2: panel, same order as the buttons
docs.tabs.inc: Tabs styles are also available alone: https://psyscripts.vercel.app/dist/tabs.min.css.
docs.themeswitcher.d: Light/dark theme, localStorage, prefers-color-scheme. Sets data-theme on <html>.
docs.themeswitcher.o0: theme list; the toggle cycles through it
docs.themeswitcher.inc: Load it in <head> without defer so the theme is applied before first paint (no flash).
docs.headermenu.d: Responsive burger menu (below 860px); Esc and outside click close it.
docs.headermenu.o0: width (px) above which the menu closes
docs.headermenu.o3: hide the header when scrolling down
docs.copybutton.d: Copy text or an element's content, with a fallback for plain HTTP.
docs.copybutton.o1: text instead of the check icon
docs.copybutton.a3: show a Toast with this text
docs.scrollreveal.a0: enable; left / right change the direction
docs.accordion.d: Smooth accordion without max-height hacks (grid rows).
docs.modal.d: Modals on native <dialog>: Esc, focus trap, backdrop click.
docs.backtotop.api: Smooth scroll is disabled under reduced-motion.
docs.backtotop.o1: selector to scroll to (top by default)
docs.lazyimages.d: Lazy loading of img and srcset via IntersectionObserver.
docs.dropdown.d: Dropdown menu: arrow keys, Esc, focus return.
docs.dropdown.a0: wrapper; data-align="right" — open to the left
docs.tooltip.d: Tooltips on hover and focus, kept inside the screen.
docs.tooltip.api: PsyScripts.Tooltip.show(el), .hide(), .set(el, text). Esc and scrolling hide the tooltip.
docs.counter.api: PsyScripts.Counter.set(el, value, {duration, easing}), .run(el); custom curves: PsyScripts.Counter.easings.name = t => …
docs.counter.o1: linear | easeOutCubic | easeInOutCubic | easeOutExpo | easeOutBack | custom
docs.carousel.d: Scroll-snap carousel: arrows, dots, keyboard, autoplay.
docs.carousel.api: PsyScripts.Carousel.init(root, opts), .get(el) → {go(i), next(), prev(), play(), pause(), refresh(), destroy()}
docs.carousel.a0: root; data-autoplay="ms", data-multi — 2 slides on wide screens
docs.formvalidation.d: Native Constraint Validation API + ARIA, custom messages.
docs.formvalidation.o1: re-check on every input after an error
docs.formvalidation.a0: on <form>; + data-ajax — fires psy:valid instead of submitting
docs.scrollspy.d: Highlights the menu link whose section is on screen.
docs.scrollspy.o0: rootMargin: which part of the screen counts as current
docs.scrollspy.a0: on <nav> or a container with #id links
docs.scrollspy.a1: class of the active link (+ aria-current)
docs.stickytoc.d: Table of contents from headings: ids, list and active highlight. On phones and small tablets (up to 860 px) it becomes a sticky “Contents · current section” bar with a drop-down list. The one on this page is exactly this.
docs.stickytoc.o5: bar caption when there is no title or aria-label
docs.stickytoc.inc: scroll-spy.min.js highlights the current section; without it the TOC still works, just without highlighting.
docs.imagelightbox.d: Image viewer: arrows, Esc, caption from alt.
docs.imagelightbox.a0: on an img or a gallery container
docs.parallax.d: Light parallax, rAF, disabled under reduced-motion.
docs.cookiebanner.d: Consent banner; the choice is stored in localStorage.
docs.cookiebanner.o3: bump the number and everyone is asked for consent again
docs.skeleton.d: Skeleton placeholder until the content is ready.
docs.skeleton.o0: ms when there are no images
docs.skeleton.a1: ms, if there are no images inside
docs.typewriter.d: Typing text: word list, speed, loop, cursor. Respects reduced-motion, pauses off-screen.
docs.typewriter.a0: words separated by | (or a JSON array); empty — the element text is used
docs.typewriter.a1: ms per character, ms per deletion, pause after a word
docs.countdown.d: Countdown to a date or a timer. Unit labels are localized with Intl and follow the language.
docs.countdown.a3: your own elements instead of auto-generated ones
docs.scrollprogress.d: Reading progress for the page or a block. Accessible progressbar, CSS variable --psy-p.
docs.scrollprogress.a0: container; the bar is created for you
docs.scrollprogress.a1: selector of the block to measure (whole page by default)
docs.scrollprogress.a3: inside the container: receives the percentage
docs.compareslider.d: Before/after slider: mouse, touch, keyboard (role=slider), horizontal and vertical modes.
docs.compareslider.a0: container with two blocks or imgs: the first is “before”, the second “after”
docs.i18n.d: Dependency-free translations: JSON files, plurals, fallback, language auto-detection, RTL.
docs.i18n.o6: allow loading translations from another origin (same-origin only by default)
docs.i18n.a3: number for plural forms and the {n} variable
docs.i18n.a4: cycle through languages or set a specific one
docs.i18n.a5: languages, default language, file path (comma-separated for several files)
docs.i18n.inc: safe-html.min.js is needed for data-i18n-html; without it those strings are rendered as plain text.
docs.commandpalette.d: Ctrl/⌘+K command palette: fuzzy search, groups, recent commands, ARIA combobox on a native <dialog>.
docs.commandpalette.api: PsyScripts.CommandPalette.open(q), .close(), .toggle(), .register(cmd | [cmd]) → remove function, .unregister(id), .list(), .search(q), .clearRecent(). Command: {id, title, group, keywords, hint, href, run(cmd)}.
docs.commandpalette.o0: combo: mod (Ctrl/⌘) + key; '' disables; '/' — no modifier
docs.commandpalette.o5: how many recent items to keep (0 disables)
docs.commandpalette.o6: localStorage key (only command ids are stored)
docs.commandpalette.a0: open button; the value is the initial query
docs.commandpalette.a1: the element becomes a command: click() is called on it when chosen
docs.commandpalette.a2: group, search keywords and a key hint
docs.commandpalette.a3: container: every a[href] inside joins the palette (http, https, mailto, tel, #anchor)
docs.commandpalette.inc: Stores only recent command ids in localStorage. Add data-command-source to expose navigation links.
docs.datatable.d: A plain <table> becomes interactive: sorting (aria-sort), search, pagination, safe CSV export.
docs.datatable.api: PsyScripts.DataTable.get(el) → {sort(col, 'asc'|'desc'), unsort(), filter(q), page(n), pages(), count(), rows(), setRows([[...]]), csv(all?), download(all?), refresh(), destroy()}. setRows inserts values as text only.
docs.datatable.a1: search input (all cells; several words = AND)
docs.datatable.a4: on <th>: number | date | text (detected automatically by default)
docs.datatable.a5: on <td>: sort value when it differs from the text
docs.datatable.a6: on <th>: do not sort this column
docs.sortable.d: Reorder list or grid items by mouse, touch, pen and keyboard (Space → arrows → Space, Esc cancels) with screen-reader announcements.
docs.sortable.api: PsyScripts.Sortable.get(el) → {order(), items(), setOrder(['b','a']), move(from, to), refresh(), disable(), destroy()}; events sortable:start, sortable:move, sortable:end {item, from, to, order}, sortable:cancel.
docs.sortable.o3: FLIP animation of siblings, ms (0 disables; respects reduced-motion)
docs.sortable.o4: px to move before dragging starts
docs.sortable.a0: container; its children are the draggable items
docs.sortable.a1: optional: marks only the children you want
docs.sortable.a2: on the container: CSS selector of the handle inside an item; without it the whole item is dragged
docs.sortable.a3: on an item: identifier for order() and the sortable:end event
docs.safehtml.d: Allow-list HTML sanitizer (DOMParser → new tree → DocumentFragment) and the “psyscripts” Trusted Types policy.
docs.safehtml.api: PsyScripts.Sanitize.set(el, html, opts?), .fragment(html, opts?) → DocumentFragment, .html(html, opts?) → string, .text(s) (escape), .url(u, schemes?), .last() → {removed, attributes, unwrapped}. Event sanitize:removed. I18n uses SafeHTML for data-i18n-html; without it the HTML is rendered as plain text.
docs.safehtml.o0: allowed tags (others are unwrapped: text is kept)
docs.safehtml.o1: allowed attributes; on*, style, id, name are always removed
docs.safehtml.o2: tags removed together with their content
docs.safehtml.o3: false — links are replaced by their text
docs.safehtml.a0: the attribute value is sanitized and rendered inside the element
docs.safehtml.inc: Load it before I18n if you use data-i18n-html.
docs.core.0: Global options for any script. Priority: data attribute → PsyScripts.opts(el, …) → configure → built-in default.
docs.core.2: Options for a single element from JS (before init). Every option also works as a data-<kebab-option> attribute.
docs.core.3: Events: PsyScripts.on('toast:show', (detail, e) => e.preventDefault()); '*' — all. The same arrives as the DOM event psy:toast:show.
docs.core.4: Design tokens: flat keys apply to all themes, {light:{…}, dark:{…}, sepia:{…}} to specific ones. Keys: bg, solid, text, muted, line, ink, accent, primary, onPrimary, lav, mint, pink, peach, sky, butter, ok, err, warn, radius, border, shadow, font, mono.
docs.core.5: Replaces a built-in icon (menu, x, check, chevron-left …) with your SVG; or override the --psy-i-menu CSS variable. Class: <i class="psy-ico psy-ico--menu">.
docs.core.6: Init/destroy all scripts for dynamic content; observe watches the DOM for you (or data-psy-observe on <html>).
docs.core.7: Create your own script with the same options, attributes, init/destroy and auto-start.
docs.core.8: Safe helpers: url returns '' for a disallowed scheme (default http, https, relative); sel/selAll never throw on an invalid selector; pick is an allow-list for values that end up in class names.
docs.core.9: html is for YOUR OWN static markup only (via Trusted Types); for foreign HTML use PsyScripts.Sanitize.set. sheet adds styles through adoptedStyleSheets: neither 'unsafe-inline' nor a nonce is needed.
docs.g.security.0: PsyScripts is a client-side library with zero dependencies and no network requests (except translation files from your own origin). Below: what it guarantees and what stays on your side. Audit results: SECURITY-AUDIT-2026-10-19.md in the repository.
docs.g.security.1.0: All text from attributes, options and translation strings is inserted through textContent; HTML from translations (data-i18n-html) goes through SafeHTML.
docs.g.security.1.1: URLs in Lightbox and LazyImages are checked against a scheme allow-list (http, https, blob:, data:image); javascript: and data:text/html are dropped.
docs.g.security.1.2: Configuration merging is protected from prototype pollution; design-token values cannot escape their CSS declaration.
docs.g.security.1.3: An invalid selector in data-copy-target, data-match or data-toc-source does not break the page.
docs.g.security.1.4: No eval, new Function, document.write, inline handlers or external hosts: a strict CSP and Trusted Types work.
docs.g.security.2: Recommended headers. This CSP is used on the project site (vercel.json): the markup has no inline styles, inline scripts or handlers (tests enforce this) and styles are added through adoptedStyleSheets, so 'unsafe-inline' is not needed. Trusted Types run in Report-Only mode: open the site, make sure the console shows no violations, then move the directive into Content-Security-Policy.
docs.g.security.4: If you need a nonce. Browsers without adoptedStyleSheets get a <style> element; pass the nonce with <meta name="psy-nonce" content="…">.
docs.g.security.6.0: Never put foreign data into innerHTML: use textContent or PsyScripts.Sanitize.set(el, html).
docs.g.security.6.1: CookieBanner only stores the consent decision (localStorage) and does not block trackers by itself: check PsyScripts.Cookie.has('analytics') before loading them.
docs.g.security.6.2: localStorage is readable by any script on the origin: never store secrets there (the library stores the theme, language, consent, tokens and command ids).
docs.g.security.6.3: Always serve the site over HTTPS: the Clipboard API and Trusted Types require a secure context.
docs.g.security.6.4: Load scripts with SRI (see “Files & SRI”) and upgrade versions deliberately.
docs.g.security.7: Found a vulnerability? Write to the contact in /.well-known/security.txt or open a private GitHub Security Advisory — please do not file a public issue.
docs.g.files.0: Every script is a separate file in https://psyscripts.vercel.app/dist/; core.min.js is required by all of them for the configuration API. SRI hashes (sha384) are generated at build time and stored in https://psyscripts.vercel.app/dist/manifest.json.
docs.g.a11y.0: Every component is keyboard-operable, has ARIA roles and respects prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-contrast.
docs.g.a11y.1.r1.1: Esc closes; Tab stays inside; ← → browse the gallery
docs.g.a11y.1.r3.1: Tab to a header button, Enter/Space sorts
docs.g.a11y.1.r4.1: Space grabs, ← → ↑ ↓ moves, Space drops, Esc cancels
docs.g.a11y.2: Touch targets are ≥ 44px, text contrast is ≥ 4.5:1 on all pastel surfaces, :focus-visible is always visible. The back-to-top button uses the high-contrast --psy-primary / --psy-on-primary pair and is visible in every light theme.
docs.g.browsers.0: Targets are current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari (last two versions) and their mobile versions.
docs.g.browsers.1.r0.2: open attribute without a focus trap
docs.g.faq.0.0: A script does nothing. Make sure core.min.js is loaded first (or use the bundle) and that the console shows no CSP violations.
docs.g.faq.0.1: Content is added later. Call PsyScripts.init(root) or enable PsyScripts.observe() / data-psy-observe on <html>.
docs.g.faq.0.2: The theme flashes. Load theme-switcher in <head> without defer.
docs.g.faq.0.3: No styles when loading scripts individually. Add https://psyscripts.vercel.app/dist/psyscripts.min.css (it includes Tabs and the icons).
docs.g.faq.0.4: CSP blocks styles. Do not add 'unsafe-inline': use the current version (adoptedStyleSheets) or pass a nonce via meta[name=psy-nonce].
docs.g.faq.0.5: data-i18n-html shows tags as text. Load safe-html.min.js — without it HTML is intentionally not inserted.
docs.g.faq.0.6: Translations do not load from a CDN. Only your own origin is allowed by default; enable data-i18n-cross-origin deliberately.
docs.g.changelog.0: 2.1.0 — 2026-10-19. New tools: CommandPalette, DataTable, Sortable, SafeHTML (31 in total). Security: prototype-pollution and CSS-injection protection for tokens, URL allow-list, translation HTML only through the sanitizer, CSP-compatible styles and Trusted Types, self-hosted fonts instead of Google Fonts, consent version, SRI manifest. Fixed: back-to-top contrast, ScrollSpy crash on a malformed %-hash, exceptions on invalid selectors. Docs: per-script include paths.
docs.g.changelog.1: 2.0.0. Configuration API, 27 scripts, events, design tokens, icons, I18n.
